files = ['my_website/index.html','my_website/blog.html','my_website/publications.html']
css = pathlib.Path('my_website/assets/style.css').read_text()
# find class attributes
class_pat = re.compile(r'class="([^"]+)"')
tokens = set()
for f in files:
    txt = pathlib.Path(f).read_text()
    for m in class_pat.finditer(txt):
        for tok in m.group(1).split():
            tokens.add(tok)
# find class selectors in css
# simple find .token\b
sel_pat = re.compile(r'\.([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)\b')
css_tokens = set(sel_pat.findall(css))
uncovered = [t for t in sorted(tokens) if t not in css_tokens]
print('Total tokens:', len(tokens))
print('Covered:', len(tokens)-len(uncovered))
print('Uncovered tokens:')
for t in uncovered:
    print(t)

others = [u for u in uses if u not in required]

top_perm = re.search(r'^permissions:\s*\n\s*contents:\s*read\s*$', p, re.M)

# d) workflow_dispatch present
checks['workflow_dispatch'] = 'workflow_dispatch:' in p
# concurrency block
checks['concurrency'] = 'concurrency:' in p and 'group: pages' in p
